title: Heart attack and stroke risk detectable decades in advance
summary:
A groundbreaking study reveals that the risk of heart attack and stroke can be detectable decades in advance, presenting a significant window for early intervention. Researchers, led by the University of Edinburgh, analyzed data from over 100,000 individuals between 1985 and 2019, identifying early patterns in both traditional and emerging cardiovascular risk factors.

They found that systolic blood pressure was consistently higher in those who later developed cardiovascular disease, starting at 4 mmHg higher three decades before an event and increasing to 7 mmHg closer to it. Distinct patterns were observed between sexes, with younger women having lower blood pressure than men, a trend that switched around age 65. Individuals experiencing cardiovascular events at a younger age also showed higher body mass index and diabetes decades prior.

Beyond traditional factors, blood biomarkers like NT-proBNP (for heart failure) showed changes over a decade before an event. Differences in kidney function and physical activity trajectories were also noted.

These findings underscore a crucial opportunity to develop early prevention strategies, utilizing patterns of risk factors and biomarkers to reduce future cardiovascular events. Experts, including Dr. Dorien Kimenai and Professor Bryan Williams of the British Heart Foundation, stress that many heart attacks and strokes are preventable. Early detection could empower individuals to make lifestyle changes or start treatment, potentially "rewriting their future." The study recommends tracking risk factors over time to improve predictions and calls for further research into non-traditional factors and ethnic differences. Currently, monitoring blood pressure and cholesterol is advised.
chinese_title: 心脏病和中风风险可提前数十年检测。
chinese_summary:
一项开创性研究揭示，心脏病发作和中风的风险可提前数十年被检测到，为早期干预提供了重要的机会。爱丁堡大学领导的研究人员分析了1985年至2019年间超过10万人的数据，识别出传统和新兴心血管风险因素的早期模式。

他们发现，在后来患上心血管疾病的人群中，收缩压持续较高，在事件发生前三十年开始高出4毫米汞柱，并在事件临近时增加到7毫米汞柱。不同性别之间观察到不同的模式：年轻女性的血压低于男性，而这一趋势在65岁左右发生逆转。在较年轻时发生心血管事件的个体，在事件发生前几十年也表现出较高的身体质量指数和糖尿病。

除了传统因素，NT-proBNP（用于心力衰竭）等血液生物标志物在事件发生前十多年就显示出变化。肾功能和体育活动轨迹的差异也得到了注意。

这些发现强调了开发早期预防策略的关键机会，利用风险因素和生物标志物的模式来减少未来的心血管事件。包括英国心脏基金会的多里安·基梅奈博士和布莱恩·威廉姆斯教授在内的专家强调，许多心脏病发作和中风是可以预防的。早期检测可以使个体有能力改变生活方式或开始治疗，从而可能“重写他们的未来”。该研究建议长期跟踪风险因素以改善预测，并呼吁进一步研究非传统因素和种族差异。目前，建议监测血压和胆固醇。

title: Taking over US Treasury subdomains for $3 each
summary:
The article details a practical method for taking over AWS Elastic IP (EIP) addresses due to dangling DNS records, costing only $3 per successful claim. Researchers demonstrated this vulnerability by automating the allocation and release of EIPs across AWS regions, checking each against a list of public bug bounty subdomains. In just 48 hours, cycling through 450,000 unique IPs (less than 1% of the total EIP space), they identified 28 live takeovers. Notably, five US Treasury subdomains (e.g., ftp.treasury.gov) were among the compromised targets.

Once an EIP is claimed, an attacker controls the associated subdomain, enabling sophisticated phishing, credential theft, data exfiltration from old automations, and even session hijacking via parent domain cookies, all under a seemingly legitimate, HTTPS-validated domain.

AWS banned the researchers' account for abuse, but they easily circumvented this by transferring the claimed EIPs to a new account within the same organization, highlighting a significant control gap. Despite suggesting organizational-level bans and EIP allocation quotas, AWS declined to implement changes, stating the issue is customer-side (dangling DNS records) rather than a flaw in their services. The attack remains practical and scalable; organizations are urged to review and rectify their dangling DNS records promptly.
chinese_title: 接管美国财政部子域名，每个3美元
chinese_summary:
本文详细介绍了一种由于悬空DNS记录而劫持AWS弹性IP（EIP）地址的实用方法，每次成功声明仅需花费3美元。研究人员通过自动化分配和释放跨AWS区域的EIP，并将其与公共漏洞赏金子域名列表进行对照检查，从而演示了这一漏洞。在短短48小时内，他们循环使用了45万个唯一的IP（不到EIP总空间的1%），识别出28起实际劫持事件。值得注意的是，五个美国财政部子域名（例如，ftp.treasury.gov）是受损目标之一。

一旦EIP被声明，攻击者就控制了相关的子域名，从而能够在一个看似合法、经过HTTPS验证的域名下进行复杂的网络钓鱼、凭证窃取、从旧自动化系统中窃取数据，甚至通过父域cookie进行会话劫持。

AWS因滥用行为封禁了研究人员的账户，但他们通过将已声明的EIP转移到同一组织内的新账户，轻易地规避了这一点，这凸显了一个重要的控制漏洞。尽管研究人员建议实施组织级别的封禁和EIP分配配额，AWS仍拒绝实施改变，声称问题出在客户侧（悬空DNS记录），而非其服务中的缺陷。这种攻击仍然实用且具有可扩展性；呼吁各组织立即审查并纠正其悬空DNS记录。
